items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I went up there to talk with him, and he like bugged me

ctx.x: Between 13th and 12th on U. On the 1300 block of U Street. There was some kind of 'N' -- I can't think of it. Anyway, that's where they used to go to rehearse. Jelly Roll was up there, and every time they'd play something, Jelly Roll would stop them. [GRANDIOSELY] 'Wait a minute! That's me. They stoled it. See, that, they stole that from me.' They were playing 'One O'Clock Jump.' [SINGS THEME] 'Ah, that's me. Right there, they stole that.' He was going crazy, you know what I mean?
I went up there to talk with him, and he like bugged me
